latest_release.name: v0.7.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: move boards between workspaces by @nickmeinhold in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/458
* fix: correct template creation condition in BoardDropdown by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/529
* feat: allow submitting comments via keyboard shortcut by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/533
* fix(editor): don't throw in suggestion onExit when no popup was created by @arsteyn in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/543
* fix(mcp): map comment content field for Kan API compatibility by @aeroluxx in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/540
* fix: prevent maximum update depth exceeded error by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/549
* perf: improvements to build time by @nahSystemu in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/555
* Add Danish translation 🇩🇰 by @HrCalmar in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/553
* fix: accept empty slug in workspace.create by @HeinrichNebula in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/545
* feat(card): attach files directly when creating a card by @HeinrichNebula in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/548
* fix: create empty boards through MCP by @mikkelvalentinsorensen in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/561
* Fix: boards page heading and tabs are not translated by @serhiihordiichuk in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/564
* perf: add indexes for card relation queries by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/566
* feat(e2e): setup test harness by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/557
* test(e2e): extend self-hosted test coverage by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/571
* feat(cloud): deprecate pro plan by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/573
* docs: add migration container to self hosting docs by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/578
* fix: preserve custom label colours when editing by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/577
* fix: scope card member assignments to the workspace by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/576
* fix: deduplicate mention emails per content change by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/574
* fix: use public base URL for login redirects by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/567
* feat: normalise empty card descriptions by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/582
* chore(tests): run unit tests on pull request by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/583
* test: update card member mock for description normalization by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/585
* perf: deduplicate avatar URL generation in API responses by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/570
* fix(db): enable pg_trgm in PGlite by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/587
* fix: preserve Trello label colours during import by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/579
* fix(card): normalise descriptions on update by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/592
* fix(trello): protect stored access tokens by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/591
* fix(board): prevent actions on optimistic lists by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/597
* feat: clarify active board filters by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/581
* perf: split trpc context from router builder by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/600
* fix: stop checklist item editor remounting after creation by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/601
* feat: add hosted mcp server by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/607
* fix(editor): restore monospace code font by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/613
* test(editor): cover markdown behavior and unsafe input by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/614
* fix(mcp): fix broken tools and false unauthorized errors on hosted server by @hjball in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/615
* fix(ci): run pinned MinIO image for E2E by @bionicman in https://github.com/kanbn/kan/pull/626
* fix(mcp): return 404 for oauth discovery paths by @h
